sermon.title: Deeper Than the Skin — June 5, 2022
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: The skin guards the body, but infection gets in through wounds; sin likewise takes root when Satan gets a foothold, going deeper than the skin. Evil comes from the heart. Like Naaman and the leper Jesus touched, come to Him to be cleansed inside and offer yourself a living sacrifice.
